aries.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Aries today.
aries.deploy_today: Maybe — Even the cosmos can't decide, and they have unlimited compute.
aries.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet for Aries today. Your Slack notifications are not. They have never been quiet.

taurus.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Taurus today.
taurus.deploy_today: Yes — If the cosmos are silent, so are your error logs. Probably.
taurus.prophecy: The stars are taking a personal day. Your ticket queue did not get the memo. Your ticket queue never gets the memo.

gemini.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Gemini today.
gemini.deploy_today: No — A quiet cosmos is just a prelude to chaos. You've seen this before.
gemini.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet for Gemini today. The cosmos have not seen your git log.

cancer.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Cancer today.
cancer.deploy_today: Maybe — Cosmic silence is a yellow light, not a green one.
cancer.prophecy: The universe has nothing to say about Cancer today. Your PM has 47 things to say. The PM always has 47 things.

leo.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Leo today.
leo.deploy_today: No — Even a quiet cosmos wouldn't approve this diff. It has 14 files changed.
leo.prophecy: The cosmos are silent on Leo's fate today. Your code review is not silent. It has never been silent. There is a comment on every line.

virgo.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Virgo today.
virgo.deploy_today: Yes — Virgo planned this deploy three sprints ago. The cosmos approve retroactively.
virgo.prophecy: The cosmos offer no guidance for Virgo today. Virgo has already written the guidance, reviewed it, and filed it under version control.

libra.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Libra today.
libra.deploy_today: Maybe — Libra has weighed both options for two hours. Libra will weigh them for two more.
libra.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet. Libra interprets this as a sign. Libra is not sure what sign. Libra opens a new tab to research it.

scorpio.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Scorpio today.
scorpio.deploy_today: No — Quiet is when things break. Scorpio knows this deeply and personally.
scorpio.prophecy: The cosmos are suspiciously quiet for Scorpio. The last time it was this quiet, there was an incident with a P0 label.

sagittarius.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Sagittarius today.

sagittarius.prophecy: The cosmos have nothing to add for Sagittarius today. Sagittarius did not ask for the cosmos' input anyway.

capricorn.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Capricorn today.
capricorn.deploy_today: No — Capricorn has seventeen dependencies to verify, two approvals pending, and a rollback plan to finalize.
capricorn.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet for Capricorn today. Capricorn has filed a ticket to investigate and assigned it to themselves.

aquarius.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Aquarius today.
aquarius.deploy_today: Yes — Aquarius deploys in silence. The cosmos are clearly on board.
aquarius.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet for Aquarius today. Aquarius reads this as implicit permission to refactor the entire authentication layer.

pisces.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Pisces today.
pisces.deploy_today: No — Pisces had a feeling. The feeling said no. The feeling is usually right.
pisces.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet for Pisces today. Pisces nods slowly. Pisces was already asleep in the standup.
